instruction: I want to customize VLC's progress slider colors to use a dark theme. Can you help me make all the slider colors blackish for better visibility at night?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires customizing VLC slider colors to be blackish (dark theme). Uses existing check_qt_slider_colours metric with type='blackish' to verify all RGB values are below threshold (100). The metric parses qt-slider-colours config and checks each RGB triplet.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to make all VLC slider colors blackish
Metric check_qt_slider_colours correctly parses qt-slider-colours config setting and validates all RGB triplets are below threshold (100)
Complete coverage: instruction requires all slider colors to be blackish, metric checks all 4 RGB color triplets
Data flow is correct: get_vlc_config extracts vlcrc file, metric reads and parses qt-slider-colours setting
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are written to disk
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] correctly without wrongly accessing rule.get('rules', {})
